from harvests import Harvest
import catalog as reg


def test_late_registration():
    reg.reset()
    reg.register(Harvest("k1", 5))
    assert len(reg.find("k1")) == 1
    reg.register(Harvest("k1", 7))
    assert [x.kilos for x in reg.find("k1")] == [5, 7]


def test_late_new_key():
    reg.reset()
    reg.register(Harvest("k1", 5))
    reg.find("k1")
    reg.register(Harvest("k9", 2))
    assert [x.kilos for x in reg.find("k9")] == [2]


def test_unknown_key():
    reg.reset()
    reg.register(Harvest("k1", 5))
    assert reg.find("nope") == []


def test_reset():
    reg.reset()
    reg.register(Harvest("k1", 5))
    reg.find("k1")
    reg.reset()
    assert reg.find("k1") == []
